test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : OLR :: PMS : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : OLR :: PMS : %

**Option 1) # = MKI, % = NHU**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/114d1d31dda845d82f39d5c70146ab011710c2e7c9cf8c2ef51dc778ad0fa405.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eed1cc20474cc187fdb68189b33602831107fedeacd5ab32c67f6d5d16b0b021.png] 

**Option 2) # = JGM, % = URX**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f59a0e604ab027012c093c0ceb9860ab2dfeb1e833311c5ccbc2f7229208967.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/142fb4529adac3d72cdbcce6c7e1b8a5ca87a139a4471197e140cc1e68d237a5.png] 

 

**Option 3) # = LKP, % = FGH**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dd98e6478af99e3ba2738f80954a0917ee4473be8e60390afba6b5362b0a428.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/036a6d854655b37ddaabc450d11e292fedc3d97b10bb3cf95a36ec9761c7f0eb.png] 

 

**Option 4) # = KLM, % = NHY**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f86f694cc68fcac209b8eebb7574bc18353b9d0fc632c42915a842cefdf2798.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ab7343b555230063e5b60a2162ad2e921f2e16fddde510b57c7cb1029e5486b.png] 

 

Based on the analysis, only Option 2 maintains a consistent pattern across both pairs.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
